# DatePicker

DatePicker — a date field that opens a month calendar (Figma `DatePicker`). Built from the shared parts: the field is `FieldBox` with the calendar icon in Trailing, and the calendar is the shared `Calendar` on the `_Listbox` surface, which DateTimePicker opens too. - **Typing:** the field takes MM/DD/YYYY (and, with `range`, two dates joined by a dash). It is checked when you press Enter or leave the field: a real day inside `minDate`…`maxDate` is picked, anything else is kept as typed and marked invalid, and `onChange` is not called. - **Range:** the first click sets the first day, the second the last; a click before the first day starts again. `onChange` receives `[start, end]`. - **Popup:** opens 4px (`--stack-sm`) below the field, left-aligned (or as `calendarAlign` asks), and flips above with the same gap when there is no room below. Props it does not name (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `data-*`) go to the input, which is the control a screen reader lands on: DatePicker has no `label` prop, so that is how a caller names it.

Also asked as: calendar input, date field, date input, date selector.

## Usage

Use `DatePicker` for a single date or a date range typed or chosen from a calendar: a session date, a billing period. For a time alone, use Time picker; for a date and a time together, use Date time picker.

## Best practices

### Typing is checked on Enter or on leaving the field. {#typing-is-checked-on-enter-or-on-leaving-the-field}

A real day inside `minDate` to `maxDate` is picked; anything else is kept exactly as typed and marked invalid, and `onChange` is not called until the text reads as a real date.

```jsx
<DatePicker
    value={date}
    onChange={setDate}
    minDate="2026-01-01"
    maxDate="2026-12-31"
/>
```

### A range is two clicks, not a drag. {#a-range-is-two-clicks-not-a-drag}

The first click sets the first day, the second sets the last day, and `onChange` receives `[start, end]`. A click before the first day starts the range again rather than erroring.

### Name the field. {#name-the-field}

There is no `label` prop. Pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; both go straight to the input.

### Show the date format as a hint. {#show-the-date-format-as-a-hint}

The field says how to type the date before anyone types it. Without a hint people guess the order. The placeholder is MM/DD/YYYY unless you replace it, so leave it.

Do: The format is shown.
Don't: No format given.

### Show dates in one format everywhere. {#show-dates-in-one-format-everywhere}

Use the same order and separators in the field, the calendar and any message. Mixed formats read as different dates.

Do: One format throughout.
Don't: A second format appears in the message.

### Use one range field, not two dates. {#use-one-range-field-not-two-dates}

A range picks start and end in one field and one calendar. Two separate fields split one decision in two.

Do: One range field.
Don't: Two separate fields.

## Accessibility

- **The input is the named control.** `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` are read straight off the props and land on the text input a screen reader focuses.
- **The popup is a labeled dialog.** It opens as `role="dialog"` with an `aria-label` of "Choose a date" or "Choose dates", not a bare list.
- **`aria-expanded` and `aria-haspopup` track the calendar's open state** on the input itself, which is `role="combobox"`.
- **An invalid typed date keeps the typed text** rather than silently reverting, so the person can see and correct what they entered.
- **Invalid is not color alone:** the input sets `aria-invalid`.

- For a time alone, use Time picker.
- For a date and a time together, use Date time picker.

## Parts

1. **Field.** A 40 box (32 at compact) on the input fill, with the date as text.
2. **Calendar icon.** Opens the calendar. Decoration for assistive technology; the input is the control.
3. **Calendar.** A month grid in a popup 4px below the field, flipped above when there is no room. A picked day is the selected fill; days between a range's ends are the neutral selection.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | `--ds-background-input` fill with a `--ds-border-input` border. |
| Hovered | The border takes `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the box. |
| Invalid | The border takes `--ds-border-danger` and the input sets `aria-invalid`. |
| Read-only | The box takes `--ds-background-neutral`. |
| Disabled | The box fades to `--ds-opacity-disabled` and leaves the tab order. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the date by its role: "Session date", "Start date". | A generic name: "Date", or "Pick a date". |
| Leave the placeholder as the format, MM/DD/YYYY. | Put an instruction in the placeholder: "Click to choose". |
| Say how to fix an invalid date: "Enter a date between October 5 and October 23". | "Invalid date". |
| Use sentence case in labels and messages. | Title case: "Session Date". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Id of the input. Falls back to `name`, then to a generated id. |
| `name` | string | — | Form key of the input. |
| `placeholder` | string | — | Placeholder text |
| `value` | string or arrayOf | — | ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; with `range`, `[start, end]`, either end may be `null`. |
| `range` | bool | `false` | Pick a first and a last day |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | Field height: 40 default, 32 compact |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Disable the picker |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Make read-only |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draw the field invalid |
| `isValid` | bool | `false` | Draw the field valid |
| `minDate` | string or instanceOf | — | Optional minimum allowed date |
| `maxDate` | string or instanceOf | — | Optional maximum allowed date |
| `calendarAlign` | enum | `'left'` | Calendar dropdown alignment |
| `onChange` | func | — | `(iso)`, or `([start, end])` with `range`; `\'\'` or nulls when cleared. |
| `onFocus` | func | — | Called with the focus event when the input gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | func | — | Called with the blur event when the input loses focus, after any typed text has been checked. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the field frame, beside `plus-date-picker`. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style on the field frame. |
